```{r lib-functions}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false


library(tidyverse); library(AOData); library(nlme); library(emmeans); library(ggtext)


data("glucose"); data("idkeys")


glucose_dat <- glucose %>%
  inner_join(idkeys) %>%
  filter(!is.na(HOMA2B), 
         min == 0) %>%
 # filter(time != "T1") %>%
  
# filter(round != 3) %>%
  
  
  dplyr::select(participant, time,sex, treat,round,bmi, HOMA2S) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = time, values_from = HOMA2S) %>%
  print()
  

 m <- lm(T4 - T1 ~ T1 + sex + bmi, data = glucose_dat) 


 summary(m)



sig_lab <- paste0("p = ", round(coef(summary(m))[4, 4], 3))



group_comp <- emmeans(m, specs = ~ treat|round) %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  ggplot(aes(treat, emmean, fill = treat)) + 
 
  geom_point(data =  mutate(glucose_dat, homa_change = T4 - T2), 
             aes(treat, homa_change), 
             shape = 21, 
             alpha = 0.4,
             size = 1.5,
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.1)) +
  
  
   geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), 
                width = 0.1) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  
  facet_wrap(~ round) +
  
  labs(y = "HOMA2 %S<sub>wk20</sub> - HOMA2 %S<sub>wk7</sub> (95% CI)") +

  annotate("segment", x = c(1, 1, 2), 
           xend = c(2, 1, 2),
           y = c(39, 39, 39), 
           yend = c(39, 32, 37)) +
  
  annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = 42.5, label = sig_lab, size = 2.7) +
  
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-30, 45), expand = c(0,0), 
                     breaks = c(-20,  -10,  0,  10,  20,  30,  40, 45), 
                     labels = c(-20,  -10,  0, 10,  20,  30,  40, "")) +


  
  theme_bw() +
  
  theme(axis.title.y = element_markdown(size = 8, color = "black"), 
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color = "black", angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        
        axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none")
  
  

glucose_dat <- glucose %>%
  inner_join(idkeys) %>%
  filter(!is.na(HOMA2S), 
         min == 0) %>%
  dplyr::select(participant, time,sex, treat,round,bmi, HOMA2S) %>%

  print()



library(nlme)

m <- lme(HOMA2S ~ time * treat + bmi + time:bmi, 
         random = list(participant = ~ 1), 
         data = glucose_dat)

summary(m)

```
